ticket.title: Sweep the suite for code that names the moved documents by root path
acceptance_criteria:
DONE 2026-11-06 the same day it was filed. Sweep of the whole suite for code naming the moved documents by root path found two real sites, both in benchwork-core, both fixed: spec_studio read SPEC.md, ARCHITECTURE.md and DESIGN.md from the root (primary_spec became None, so the studio showed nothing) and capabilities.rs probed root_path.join(candidate) for all nine (the capabilities endpoint understated the repository). Both now resolve through spec_studio::resolve_doc, which checks root then docs/.

Everything else checked and clean: no include_str!/include_bytes! over documents anywhere; the TypeScript panel refers to document KEYS rather than paths, so bundle lookups are unaffected; chalkline was never root-only because it is config-driven; no shell scripts name the moved files.

Why neither was caught by a test: both degrade to 'not found' rather than failing, which is the same silence-as-success pattern the rest of this session removed. The general lesson: a file move is a breaking change for every string literal that names the file, and grep for those literals is the migration's actual test.
